species: Mass spectrometry data was searched against NCBI Human RefSeq protein database (Version 65) supplemented with common contaminants using Mascot (version 2.2.0) and SEQUEST search algorithms.
tissue: We employed tandem mass tag (TMT)-based labeling technology coupled with anti-phosphotyrosine antibody-based enrichment approach to identify differentially phosphorylated proteins between normal oral keratinocyte OKF6/TERT1, and a panel of HNSCC cell lines (JHU-O11, JHU-O22, JHU-O28, JHU-O29, FaDu and CAL 27) (Supplementary Fig. 1).

disease_state: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
To identify activated tyrosine kinase signaling pathways in HNSCC, we compared the phosphotyrosine profiles of a panel of HNSCC cell lines to a normal oral keratinocyte cell line.
